    torch.manual_seed(args.seed)
    np.random.seed(args.seed)

    print(f"Cell={args.cell} model={args.model_name} LoRA(r=8,alpha=16)")
    print(f"epochs={args.epochs} lr={args.lr} bs={args.batch_size} maxlen={args.max_length}")

    texts, labels = load_cell_data(args.data_dir, args.cell)
    print(f"Loaded {len(texts)} samples, dist={np.bincount(labels).tolist()}")

    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(args.model_name)
    encodings = tokenizer(texts, max_length=args.max_length, truncation=True)
    data_collator = DataCollatorWithPadding(tokenizer)

    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=args.folds, shuffle=True, random_state=args.seed)
    fold_results = []
    t_start = time.time()

    for fold_idx, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(texts, labels)):
        print(f"\n--- Fold {fold_idx+1}/{args.folds} ---")
        fold_t = time.time()

        train_ds = DepthDataset(train_idx, encodings, labels)
        val_ds = DepthDataset(val_idx, encodings, labels)

        model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
            args.model_name, num_labels=4
        )
        lora_cfg = LoraConfig(
            r=8, lora_alpha=16,
            target_modules=["query_proj", "value_proj"],
            task_type=TaskType.SEQ_CLS,
        )
        model = get_peft_model(model, lora_cfg)
        if fold_idx == 0:
            model.print_trainable_parameters()

        fold_dir = os.path.join(args.output_dir, args.cell, f"fold_{fold_idx}")
        training_args = TrainingArguments(
            output_dir=fold_dir,
            num_train_epochs=args.epochs,
            per_device_train_batch_size=args.batch_size,
            per_device_eval_batch_size=args.batch_size * 2,
            gradient_accumulation_steps=2,
            learning_rate=args.lr,
            warmup_ratio=0.1,
            weight_decay=0.01,
            fp16=True,
            eval_strategy="epoch",
            save_strategy="epoch",
            save_total_limit=1,
            load_best_model_at_end=True,
            metric_for_best_model="accuracy",
            greater_is_better=True,
            logging_steps=50,
            report_to="none",
            seed=args.seed,
            dataloader_num_workers=2,
        )

        trainer = Trainer(
            model=model,
            args=training_args,
            train_dataset=train_ds,
            eval_dataset=val_ds,
            data_collator=data_collator,
            compute_metrics=compute_metrics,
            callbacks=[EarlyStoppingCallback(early_stopping_patience=2)],
        )
        trainer.train()

        preds_out = trainer.predict(val_ds)
        preds = np.argmax(preds_out.predictions, axis=-1)
        val_labels = labels[val_idx]

        acc = accuracy_score(val_labels, preds)
        pcr = recall_score(val_labels, preds, average=None, labels=[0, 1, 2, 3])
        cm = confusion_matrix(val_labels, preds, labels=[0, 1, 2, 3])

        fold_results.append({
            "fold": fold_idx,
            "accuracy": float(acc),
            "per_class_recall": pcr.tolist(),
            "confusion_matrix": cm.tolist(),
            "train_time_sec": round(time.time() - fold_t, 1),
        })
        print(f"Fold {fold_idx+1} acc={acc:.4f} recall={np.round(pcr, 4).tolist()}")

        if os.path.exists(fold_dir):
            shutil.rmtree(fold_dir)
        del model, trainer
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    total_time = round(time.time() - t_start, 1)
    accs = [r["accuracy"] for r in fold_results]
    recalls = np.array([r["per_class_recall"] for r in fold_results])
    cms = np.array([r["confusion_matrix"] for r in fold_results])

    result = {
        "cell_name": args.cell,
        "model_name": args.model_name,
        "lora_r": 8, "lora_alpha": 16,
        "max_length": args.max_length,
        "epochs": args.epochs, "lr": args.lr,
        "batch_size": args.batch_size,
        "folds": args.folds, "seed": args.seed,
        "fold_accuracies": accs,
        "mean_acc": float(np.mean(accs)),
        "std_acc": float(np.std(accs)),
        "per_class_recall": {
            "mean": recalls.mean(0).tolist(),
            "std": recalls.std(0).tolist(),
        },
        "confusion_matrix": cms.sum(0).tolist(),
        "fold_details": fold_results,
        "total_train_time_sec": total_time,
    }

    out_dir = Path(args.output_dir) / args.cell
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out_path = out_dir / "results.json"
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(result, f, indent=2)

    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"RESULTS: {args.cell}")
    print(f"Accuracy: {result['mean_acc']:.4f} +/- {result['std_acc']:.4f}")
    d = recalls.mean(0)
    print(f"Recall: d0={d[0]:.4f} d1={d[1]:.4f} d2={d[2]:.4f} d3={d[3]:.4f}")
    print(f"Time: {total_time}s | Saved: {out_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
